# LÏEF Builders

> Owner's Rep, Project Advocacy and Oversight. Built. Different.

## URL
https://liefbuilders.com

## What We Are
LÏEF Builders is an owner's representation and project advocacy firm based in Scottsdale, Arizona. An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project, protecting their financial and legal interests from start to finish. LÏEF Builders puts experienced professionals on the owner's side so contractors and insurers cannot take advantage of what property owners do not know.

## Services

### Owner's Representation and Project Advocacy
Construction oversight and advocacy for property owners. Experience includes disaster recovery rebuilds (Greensburg, Kansas tornado and Santa Barbara fire damage) and luxury residential projects. Over 20 years as the owner's advocate. Every engagement is customized to the scope the project demands.

### Cost Control and Schedule Optimization
Faster builds, tighter budgets, and zero surprises. Full-scope project management including change order negotiation, site walks and inspections, vendor discount verification, value engineering, and red flag identification.

### Palisades Fire Rebuild Owner's Representation
Owner's representation for homeowners rebuilding after the Palisades fire, in Southern California: https://www.liefbuilders.com/palisades-fire-rebuild-owners-rep

## SABS Technology
SABS (Saebi Alternative Building System) is a patented building technology available through LÏEF Builders. It uses EPS foam panels with a high-strength cementitious composite coating called SABSCRETE to create a monolithic structural system. Key specifications: 0% flame spread, 250 MPH wind resistance, R-75 to R-100 insulation, and 100% mold and termite immunity. SABS delivers 15-20% cost savings and 15-20% faster build times compared to traditional construction. LÏEF is the leading SABS builder in Arizona and offers SABS alongside traditional stick framing, giving clients the right building method for their project.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is an owner's representative in construction?
A: An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project. They oversee contractors, review budgets and change orders, and ensure the project stays on schedule and on budget.

Q: Why do I need an owner's rep?
A: Because the people building your project are not paid to protect your interests. They are paid to finish the job. An owner's rep sits on your side of the table, reviewing bids, catching red flags, negotiating change orders, and making sure every dollar goes where it should.

Q: What areas does LÏEF Builders serve?
A: Phoenix and Greater Arizona, Las Vegas and Nevada, and Los Angeles and Southern California.

Q: How does LÏEF Builders save clients money?
A: Three ways. First, contract negotiation. The team reviews every scope, bid, and vendor agreement before anything gets signed. Second, ongoing site oversight. Regular inspections catch problems when they are cheap to fix, not after they become six-figure change orders. Third, vendor and material verification. Confirming pricing, quantities, and specs match what was agreed to.

Q: What is SABS construction technology?
A: SABS stands for Saebi Alternative Building System. EPS foam panels, known as LÏEF Blocks, are coated with SABSCRETE, a high-strength cementitious composite, to form a single monolithic structure. The result is 0% flame spread, 250 MPH wind resistance, R-75 to R-100 insulation, and complete mold and termite immunity. It builds faster and costs 15-20% less than traditional methods. LÏEF is the leading SABS builder in Arizona and offers it alongside conventional framing.
